messages:
Tessa: Quick lockdown thread for the beta launch blog. Need hero locked, 3 proof bullets, CTA links, and bench phrasing. Can we do a 30m sweep? :calendar:
Marco: On hero and CTAs. Will post two social headlines and a short alt hero in the doc in 15.
Kim: I'll draft the benchmark blurb and include test context (hw, seq len). Plan to call out median and p95.
Rafael: Webinar/demo ops: we have a 10:30 PT and 17:00 PT pod today. Recommend 17:00 for international. I can reserve and update event copy.
Izzy: HubSpot form + UTMs are my thing. Need final utm_campaign and demo_slot field name. Also routing to SF owner.
June (Legal): Heads-up: legal wants qualifiers. Use "up to" and add "in our internal benchmarks". No absolutes. I can review final by 4pm.
Marco: Dropped doc link: https://docs.google.com/xxx — hero chosen = short punchy line. Social alt: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency, not guesswork."
Kim: Bench drafted: "median latency up to 3.1x faster, p95 up to 2.0x in our internal benchmarks (tests run on 1x A100-equivalent; avg seq ≈128)." Keeping "up to" and "internal" per legal.
Izzy: HubSpot hidden fields for copy/paste:
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: redwood_beta_q3
  demo_slot: 17:00
  lead_route: beta_pipeline
```
Izzy: Routing rule: utm_campaign=redwood_beta_q3 -> owner = "beta-inbound"; if company_tier = "enterprise" then owner = "Enterprise AE". Also add sf_lead_flag = "beta_interest" on submit.
Rafael: Pinned 17:00 demo and updated Calendly/event title to "Redwood Beta Launch Demo". Test RSVP flow returns confirmation email ok.
June (Legal): I reviewed the doc and approved the bench language and CTAs with a minor tweak: add parenthetical "(subject to qualification)" to the dedicated eval CTA.
Tessa: Great. Final CTAs: primary = "Register for launch demo"; secondary = "Request a dedicated eval (subject to qualification)". Social headline and alt included.
Marco: I'll add social copy variants and short thread for Twitter. Also adding UTM examples for assets (landing, email, social).
Kim: Added one-line workload context into the bench blurb to be explicit about batch mix and harness.
Tessa: Proposed publish window = tomorrow 10am PT. If no flags by 4pm today I'll schedule publish and set the tweet thread for 10:05am. :rocket:
June (Legal): Sign-off recorded in doc comments.
Marco: Copy locked. Leaving one small alternate hero for the marketing team to A/B test after publish.
Tessa: Thanks team — closing this sprint.
